thread:
incident-bot: P0 - CI / deploy pipelines failing across regions. Multiple GitHub Actions runs returning 5xx and package fetches failing. Paging on-call.

oncall-amber: ack. seeing a spike of failures from `api.github.com` and `npm.pkg.github.com` in the last 3m. Pulls time out, Actions API 503s.

sre-jordan: I can take this. Amber, want to hand off?

oncall-amber: handing to Jordan. i'm tied up with an unrelated latency alert in eu-west-1. grab it and please add context to the incident doc.

sre-jordan: grabbing job logs now. representative failure snippet:
```
Run actions/checkout@v3
Error: GET https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/runs -> 503 Service Unavailable
npm ERR! code E502
npm ERR! 502 Bad Gateway - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/org/repo/-/package-1.2.3.tgz
```

eng-platform-maya: Confirmed — our hotfix pipeline can't build images. Runners hang during checkout/cache and package installs fail. This blocks any emergency build.

devops-lee: Can we use self-hosted runners to avoid GitHub cloud? Note: they still need the API for auth and packages, but maybe we can run a fully offline build if we have cached tarballs and push to our registry.

sre-jordan: checked config: self-hosted runners use GH PATs + token exchange against api.github.com, and package pulls point to `npm.pkg.github.com`. so they're impacted too.

customer-success-ana: CS is getting pressure — a few customers are asking for hotfix ETA. They've escalated to P1 on support for one account.

sre-jordan: mitigation options on the table:
- attempt manual build on an isolated builder using vendored/cached deps (if cached tgz exists)
- rollback to last known-good image from our internal registry (fastest)
- notify customers and block the hotfix until vendor restores services

eng-platform-maya: we have the prior release image in gcr `gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-10`. rollback is fastest and reduces immediate customer impact.

product-ops-tom: agree with rollback to reduce user-facing errors. prepare a short customer-facing notice: "We can serve traffic, but hotfix deployments are delayed due to third-party CI and package registry outage (GitHub Actions / Packages)."

sre-jordan: initiating rollback to previous image in prod-canary now.

incident-bot: action taken: rollback initiated by sre-jordan at 1768002129.

oncall-amber: GH status page shows degraded performance for Actions & Packages: https://www.githubstatus.com/ — incident reported ~10m ago.

devops-lee: opened org support ticket with GitHub, included request IDs & sample logs. Case: GH-78910.

sre-jordan: rollback completed in canary at 1768002250, metrics look stable vs the regression. continuing to monitor for 10m.

customer-success-ana: drafting advisory to customers. Will notify P1 accounts that hotfixes are blocked until GitHub fixes their services; offering rollback mitigation details.

product-ops-tom: approved the message. Also prep an internal exec blurb: "Third-party outage (GitHub Actions / Packages) blocked our CI and package pulls; we rolled back to previous image to reduce impact. No customer data exposure. Support ticket GH-78910 opened."

sre-jordan: monitoring frontend error rates — dropped after rollback. Note: we still cannot build new images; hotfix pipelines remain blocked.

oncall-amber: i'm wrapping up my task; Jordan, want me to take over the incident when i'm free or will you stay?

sre-jordan: i'll remain primary until GH resolves or we have a viable local-build path. i'll post updates here.

incident-bot: incident note appended: third-party (GitHub) outage preventing builds and deploys; rollback executed to mitigate customer impact. Severity P1 retained due to blocked hotfixes. Last update: 1768002760.

eng-platform-maya: next steps once GH resolves:
- validate Actions API & package pulls with a smoke build
- re-run hotfix pipelines to confirm image builds succeed
- if builds still fail, attempt local builder with vendored deps and manual image push as fallback

devops-lee: collecting and saving all failed request IDs, timestamps, and runner logs to the incident artifact bucket for postmortem. link: gs://redwood-incidents/1768002001/

customer-success-ana: customer advisory posted to affected accounts; will follow up if GH posts ETA. :thumbsup:

product-ops-tom: exec summary queued for distribution to leadership. keep updates short and timestamped.

sre-jordan: marking this thread as active responder. will update when GitHub status changes or builds resume.

-- end of thread --
